raven_count_progression_label: Use the count pattern across the matrix to choose the option that completes the missing lower-right cell.
Which labeled option completes the matrix when the visible rule is about object counts?
Select the option whose number of objects fits the count progression in the matrix.
Choose the panel that belongs in the missing cell by following the count pattern.
Identify the option that completes the 3 by 3 matrix under the count rule.
raven_spatial_transform_label: Use the rotations and reflections across the matrix to choose the option that completes the missing lower-right cell.
Which labeled option completes the matrix when the visible rule transforms the filled-cell pattern?
Select the option whose mini-grid pattern fits the spatial transform rule.
Choose the panel that belongs in the missing cell by following the spatial transformations.
Identify the option that completes the 3 by 3 matrix under the rotation/reflection rule.
raven_set_operation_label: In each row, the third panel is formed from a set operation on the first two panels. Choose the option for the missing lower-right cell.
Which labeled option completes the matrix when the row rule combines the first two filled-cell patterns?
Select the option whose filled cells match the row-wise set operation.
Choose the panel that belongs in the missing cell by applying the same set operation used in the other rows.
Identify the option that completes the 3 by 3 matrix under the row set-operation rule.
raven_analogical_transform_label: Use the changing shape, color, or size attributes across the matrix to choose the option that completes the missing lower-right cell.
Which labeled option completes the matrix when the visible rule changes object attributes?
Select the option whose object attributes fit the analogical pattern.
Choose the panel that belongs in the missing cell by following the attribute transformations.
Identify the option that completes the 3 by 3 matrix under the attribute rule.
raven_position_progression_label: Use the marker-position progression across the matrix to choose the option that completes the missing lower-right cell.
Which labeled option completes the matrix when the visible rule moves a marker through the mini-grid?
Select the option whose marker position fits the matrix progression.
Choose the panel that belongs in the missing cell by following the position pattern.
Identify the option that completes the 3 by 3 matrix under the marker-position rule.
